crossRefs.note: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.
But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,
Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?
When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.”
You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now will I lie down in the dust. You will seek me…
crossRefs.keyword: I am not. that is, I can live no longer

translations.web: The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.
translations.bsb: The eye that beholds me will no longer see me. You will look for me, but I will be no more.
translations.kjv: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more: thine eyes
translations.asv: The eye of him that seeth me shall behold me no more; Thine eyes shall be upon me, but I shall not be.
